title: Polish Chicken Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful Polish chicken skewers with a lightly breaded crust, featuring a hint of mustard and sansho pepper, perfect for a kid-friendly dinner
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and mix with mustard and sansho pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the egg mixture and coat evenly.
Then, coat the chicken pieces in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured chicken pieces in the beaten egg and finally coat with breadcrumbs.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the breaded chicken skewers in batches until golden brown, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the skewers from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the Polish chicken skewers hot and enjoy.
